name: Short-Term Reversal (42d)
description: Short-horizon mean-reversion across equity ETFs. Ranks assets by trailing ~42-trading-day (2 month) total return and holds the bottom 3 worst performers equal-weighted, exploiting price reversal on short horizons. Jegadeesh (1990) 1-month cross-sectional reversal anomaly extended to 2-month lookback.
